units.source_text: 即便如此，他们还是把我名下的所有财产给整理出来了。

en.t: Even so, they still sorted out all the property that was in my name.

units.source_text: 换算成钱的话，比我预想的数额要少得多。

en.t: When converted into money, the amount was far less than I had expected.

units.source_text: 我只有两条路可以选：要么默默地忍了，要么和叔叔对簿公堂。

en.t: I had only two choices: either endure it in silence, or take my uncle to court.

units.source_text: 我气愤极了，却又犹豫不决。

en.t: I was furious, but at the same time I hesitated.

units.source_text: 我担心打官司要拖拖拉拉很长时间，再加上我正在求学期间，作为学生，失去宝贵的学习时间是非常痛苦的事情。

en.t: I feared that a lawsuit would drag on for a very long time, and since I was still studying, losing precious time as a student would be extremely painful.

units.source_text: 我权衡再三后，请住在市里的中学时的朋友，把我继承的家产全部变卖，换成现金。

en.t: After weighing it over and over, I asked an old middle school friend living in the city to sell off all the family property I had inherited and turn it into cash.

units.source_text: 老同学劝告我这样做不太划算，但是我没有听。

en.t: My old classmate advised me that doing so would not be very worthwhile, but I did not listen.

units.source_text: 因为那时，我下了决心，要永远离开故乡，发誓再也不跟叔叔见面。

en.t: Because by then I had resolved to leave my hometown forever, and had sworn never to see my uncle again.

units.source_text: 离开故乡之前，我又去了父母的坟前。

en.t: Before leaving my hometown, I went once more to my parents' graves.

units.source_text: 从那以后，我再也没有去看过他们，恐怕永远也没有机会再去看他们了。

en.t: Since then, I have never visited them again, and I probably never will have the chance to visit them again.
